result.headline: Actuator output ch[4] froze at 1500 us from t=72.47 s while other channels kept moving
result.explanation: ch[4] stopped varying and held 1500 us to the end while ch[3] and ch[5] kept moving. A control fault on that channel is likely. The recording does not show who or what commanded the hold.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[4]] was varying, then held 1500 from t=72.47 s to the end of the recording (23.564 s, 72 samples)
evidence.shows: ch[4] output froze at neutral to the end of the recording, with no mode event around it

evidence.quote: CHANGE actuator.output[ch[5]] at t=79.496 s: 1609 -> 1480 us (step -129, 11.7x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: ch[5] still responded to a manoeuvre after ch[4] froze

evidence.quote: CHANGE actuator.output[ch[4]] at t=7.174 s: 1577 -> 1440 us (step -137, 22.8x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: before the freeze ch[4] moved together with ch[5] and ch[3] at the same manoeuvre

evidence.quote: CHANGE actuator.output[ch[7]] at t=93.335 s: 1926 -> 1101 us (step -825, 1000x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: A late, separate step on ch[7], which was constant before; probably not tied to ch[4], cause unknown

checked.result: ch[4] spread 13 -> 0 and frozen_after is true. The largest level changes are yaw and velocity, which are manoeuvres. Roll tracking error ratio is 4.78, but roll tracking misses also appear earlier in the flight (a3, a6).
Yaw and roll setpoints left baseline first, at 71.632 and 72.169 s, then vehicle states, then ch[1] and ch[2]. ch[4] never left baseline because it was already at 1500. No event precedes the freeze.
Only two start-up events at t=0.379 s (Low voltage, Sensor helth). No earlier cases in the workspace.
ch[1] and ch[2] follow throttle. ch[0] and ch[6] are constant for the whole recording, so they were never active. airspeed and yaw_rate are constant at 0.

effects.quote: CHANGE control.attitude_setpoint[roll] at t=86.775 s: -43.69 -> 20.58 deg (step 64.27, 221.6x its usual variation)
effects.why: Large roll steps recur at t=4.798 s and t=77.06 s too, so they are a repeating manoeuvre, not a consequence of the freeze

effects.quote: ANOMALY a3 t=8.068 s: vehicle.attitude[roll] did not follow control.attitude_setpoint[roll] (peak |error| 15.771) (see line 81; strength 2.807)
effects.why: Roll tracking misses occur before the freeze as well, so they are not evidence of it
